options.name: Bleeding Attack
options.benefit: A sneak attack can cause ongoing bleed damage equal to the number of sneak attack dice.

options.name: Combat Trick
options.benefit: Gain one combat feat for which you qualify.

options.name: Fast Stealth
options.benefit: Move at full speed while using Stealth without penalty.

options.name: Finesse Rogue
options.benefit: Gain Weapon Finesse as a bonus feat.

options.name: Ledge Walker
options.benefit: Move at full speed along narrow surfaces without becoming flat-footed.

options.name: Major Magic
options.benefit: Cast one chosen 1st-level sorcerer/wizard spell twice per day as a spell-like ability.

options.name: Minor Magic
options.benefit: Cast one chosen 0-level sorcerer/wizard spell three times per day as a spell-like ability.

options.name: Quick Disable
options.benefit: Disable a trap in half the normal time, or open a lock as a standard action.

options.name: Resiliency
options.benefit: Gain temporary hit points once per day when reduced below 0 hit points.

options.name: Rogue Crawl
options.benefit: Crawl at half speed and take a 5-foot step while prone.

options.name: Slow Reactions
options.benefit: A foe damaged by your sneak attack cannot make attacks of opportunity for 1 round.

options.name: Stand Up
options.benefit: Stand from prone as a free action while still provoking normally.

options.name: Surprise Attack
options.benefit: Treat opponents as flat-footed during the surprise round even if they have acted.

options.name: Trap Spotter
options.benefit: Receive an automatic Perception check when within 10 feet of a trap.

options.name: Weapon Training
options.benefit: Gain Weapon Focus with a chosen weapon as a bonus feat.

options.name: Crippling Strike
options.benefit: Deal 2 points of Strength damage with each sneak attack.

options.name: Defensive Roll
options.benefit: Attempt a Reflex save once per day to halve damage from a potentially lethal blow.

options.name: Dispelling Attack
options.benefit: A sneak attack can dispel an active spell effect on the target.

options.name: Feat
options.benefit: Gain any feat for which you qualify; this advanced talent may be selected multiple times.

options.name: Improved Evasion
options.benefit: Take only half damage on a failed Reflex save against attacks that allow half damage.

options.name: Opportunist
options.benefit: Make one attack of opportunity each round against a foe struck in melee by another character.

options.name: Skill Mastery
options.benefit: Choose 3 plus Intelligence modifier skills and take 10 with them even under stress; this talent may be selected multiple times.

options.name: Slippery Mind
options.benefit: Retry a failed save against an enchantment one round later.

options.name: Assault Leader
options.benefit: Once per day, let a flanking ally attack immediately after you miss the flanked opponent.

options.name: Befuddling Strike
options.benefit: A sneak attack penalizes the target's attacks against you for 1d4 rounds.

options.name: Camouflage
options.benefit: Craft natural camouflage once per day for a +4 Stealth bonus in matching terrain.

options.name: Canny Observer
options.benefit: Gain +4 Perception to hear conversations or find concealed and secret objects.

options.name: Charmer
options.benefit: Roll twice on a Diplomacy check a scaling number of times per day.

options.name: Coax Information
options.benefit: Use Bluff or Diplomacy instead of Intimidate to force friendly behavior.

options.name: Combat Swipe
options.benefit: Gain Improved Steal as a bonus feat.

options.name: Cunning Trigger
options.benefit: Set off a trap you constructed within 30 feet as a swift action.

options.name: Distracting Attack
options.benefit: Forfeit sneak attack damage to make the target flat-footed to one ally.

options.name: Expert Leaper
options.benefit: Always count as having a running start and ignore more deliberate falling distance.

options.name: Fast Fingers
options.benefit: Roll twice on a Sleight of Hand check a scaling number of times per day.

options.name: Fast Getaway
options.benefit: Withdraw with a move action after a successful sneak attack or Sleight of Hand check.

options.name: Fast Picks
options.benefit: Attempt to open a lock as a standard action.

options.name: Follow Clues
options.benefit: Use Perception instead of Survival to follow tracks.

options.name: Guileful Polyglot
options.benefit: Learn two additional languages, or four when trained in Linguistics.

options.name: Hard to Fool
options.benefit: Roll twice on a Sense Motive check a scaling number of times per day.

options.name: Honeyed Words
options.benefit: Roll twice on a Bluff check a scaling number of times per day.

options.name: Lasting Poison
options.benefit: Prepare poison to last for two successful attacks, with a +2 bonus on saves against it.

options.name: Nimble Climber
options.benefit: Attempt a harder Climb check to arrest a fall after a serious failure.

options.name: Offensive Defense
options.benefit: Gain a dodge bonus to AC for 1 round after a melee sneak attack.

options.name: Peerless Maneuver
options.benefit: Roll twice on an Acrobatics check a scaling number of times per day.

options.name: Positioning Attack
options.benefit: Once per day after a melee hit, move up to 30 feet without provoking and remain adjacent.

options.name: Powerful Sneak
options.benefit: Take -2 on a full attack to treat sneak attack damage dice results of 1 as 2.

options.name: Quick Disguise
options.benefit: Create disguises much faster using items at hand.

options.name: Quick Trapsmith
options.benefit: Set a prepared simple trap as a full-round action.

options.name: Snap Shot
options.benefit: Act at initiative 20 in a surprise round when making a ranged attack.

options.name: Sniper's Eye
options.benefit: Apply sneak attack on ranged attacks against foes with concealment within 30 feet.

options.name: Strong Impression
options.benefit: Gain Intimidating Prowess as a bonus feat.

options.name: Survivalist
options.benefit: Add Heal and Survival to your class skills.

options.name: Swift Poison
options.benefit: Apply poison to a weapon as a move action.

options.name: Another Day
options.benefit: Once per day, step out of a lethal melee attack's reach and become staggered next turn.

options.name: Deadly Cocktail
options.benefit: Apply two poison doses to a weapon at once for separate or enhanced effects.

options.name: Deadly Sneak
options.benefit: When using Powerful Sneak, treat sneak attack damage dice results of 1 or 2 as 3.

options.name: Entanglement of Blades
options.benefit: A melee sneak attack prevents the target from taking a 5-foot step for 1 round.

options.name: Fast Tumble
options.benefit: Move at full speed through threatened squares without the usual +10 Acrobatics DC.

options.name: Frugal Trapsmith
options.benefit: Construct mechanical traps for 75% of their normal cost.

options.name: Hunter's Surprise
options.benefit: Once per day, apply sneak attack damage to every attack against one adjacent enemy for a round.

options.name: Knock-Out Blow
options.benefit: Once per day, forgo sneak attack damage to render a target unconscious or staggered.

options.name: Master of Disguise
options.benefit: Once per day, gain +10 on a Disguise check.

options.name: Redirect Attack
options.benefit: Once per day, redirect a melee attack that hit you toward an adjacent creature.

options.name: Stealthy Sniper
options.benefit: Reduce the Stealth penalty for sniping from -20 to -10.

options.name: Thoughtful Reexamining
options.benefit: Once per day, reroll a Knowledge, Perception, or Sense Motive check made that day.
